HOP DONG CUNG CAP DICH VU VA THIET BI
(Tai lieu gia lap dung de kiem thu OCR / IDP - khong co gia tri phap ly)
So: 20/09/2026/HD-MAU
Hom nay, ngay 20 thang 09 nam 2026, tai Ha Noi, chung toi gom co cac ben sau day:
BEN A - BEN DAT HANG
Cong ty TNHH Du lieu Mau Viet Nam; Dia chi: So 10 Duong Kiem Thu, Ha Noi; Ma so thue: 0100000000;
Dai dien: Nguyen Van A - Giam doc.
BEN B - BEN CUNG CAP
Cong ty Co phan Giai phap OCR Demo; Dia chi: So 25 Duong Pipeline, Ha Noi; Ma so thue: 0100000001;
Dai dien: Tran Thi B - Giam doc du an.
DIEU 1. NOI DUNG VA PHAM VI CONG VIEC
Ben B cung cap thiet bi, dich vu trien khai va ho tro van hanh theo bang khoi luong chi tiet tai Dieu 2.
Bang duoc co y thiet ke lien trang de kiem thu kha nang noi bang cua he thong OCR/IDP.
DIEU 2. GIA TRI HOP DONG
Tong gia tri tam tinh: 486.750.000 VND (Da bao gom VAT). Gia tri cuoi cung duoc xac dinh theo khoi
luong nghiem thu va cac phu luc kem theo.
DIEU 3. THANH TOAN VA NGHIEM THU
1. Dot 1: 30% sau khi ky hop dong va tiep nhan ke hoach trien khai.
2. Dot 2: 50% sau khi hoan thanh ban giao thiet bi va nghiem thu ky thuat.
3. Dot 3: 20% sau khi ket thuc bao hanh ban giao giai doan dau.
Bang chi tiet bat dau tu trang 2.
